text:
You are of a height just above the average and are shapely and handsome, beard and hair are abundant, soft and wavy, of a beautiful sunny shade of blond; forehead is broad, but not too high, eyes are large, almond-shaped, brilliantly lit and with the whites pure and limpid.  Body not [NA1]stout, muscular, without superabundance of fat.  Walk with firm elasticity and movements show the absence of any effort; like athletes. Wheatish complexion. All parts of body will be fit till death. Impressive outlook. 
      Almost well balanced health throughout life, negligible periods of ailments in life, the fact of being essentially hopeful and looking only at the bright side of things contributing greately to physical welfare.  Health is again gainer by disposition of fond of good things of life.  Weak point is eyesight and irregular beat of heart. Body of hot temperament,(pitta type). Death will not be unnatural rather peaceful. The voice is not very strong, but of a charming tone and quite convincing and impressive, eloquent with ease, not always very deep, but ever pleasing and easily understood. Courageous, full of self-confidence, disliking restraint, egoistic, clean hearted, can't retain enemity for long, straightforward, domineering tendencies, keen towards fame and popularity. Don't like to beg help from others. Abstains from below status deeds. Weak point is habit of speaking out mind too quickly and too frankly, in fact, likes to hear himself talk.  In religion, not very fanatic, but an easily convinced believer, without a superstitious trait.  By intuition, penetrate quite deeply the mysteries of occult sciences, brain power loves to tackle high, difficult problems.  Disposition is cheerful and kindly, not especially amorous, except of beauty for its own sake; women often abuse his good-humoured laxity. Gets angry quickly, and cools off at once; never bears a grudge and generally ends by making friends worst enemies, but brilliancy inspires so much envy that you have but few real friends. You are not dissipated in your habits and are fond of healthy open air exercise; you are a great traveller. Your most ardent wish is to render your name both famous and esteemed.  
      Sharp and stable intellect. Learn everything almost by intuition and without the need of hard study. Their versatility is surprising, and so is love for everything that is beautiful in nature. They are consequently very fond of fine clothes, rich furniture and splendid jewels. They have a clear logical understanding of most problems, be it religious, intellectual or even of a business nature. 
      Either delayed progeny or miscarriage of first pregnancy but surely a long lived son. Less gain from elder brother.  Either they will be below your status or no one. Though there will be opposition from relatives yet you will always remain courteous and sympathetic towards them. You will have faithful friends who will stand in thick and     thin and will be trustworthy. Will serve father till end. 
      You will be benefitted through men in position and will have contacts with high ranking personalities. Either successful inGovernment service or main dealing with Government concerns. You will rise and make platform of life during the years from     19th to 28th of your age. Will lead strugglesome and laborious life. Career will not be below dignity. There is no condition of ancestral property yet you will leave large assets for your children. You will lead some organisation in any part of your life.

Person born under the influence of such stars is generally 'YES MAN' because he does not have the tendency to talk against the ongoing conversation.  His conversation is quite hesitating and slow.  Such natives lead their lives usually in consultation with their well-wishers and also in accordance with general people.  Their facial outlook is having some sort of complex.  They do not have superiority complex inspite of being well set materially. 
      They are imaginative, artistic and romantic in nature and are planners, build castles in the air.  They are not as forceful in carrying out their ideas.  Therefore, they should be conscious of being restless and uncertain, lack of continuity of plans and ideas, over-sensitiveness and lack of confidence.
      Their weak point is that they are unusually emotional and suffer a lot on this account in the run of their lives. They are in the habit of taking pity even on crocodile tears shed by strangers and not to speak of deserving candidates.  This undue pity leads them in hot waters.  They have the least tendency to refuse a person who has come to their door.  They should curb this tendency.
      Because they are restless in nature, so they are advised to keep themselves always on the move as much as possible.  Love change and travel.  Like newness and changeability.  That is why they feel upset while being forced to live in a fixed place or environment.  They are advised to have a out of door round to some watery place or some friend's house.  If you are still upset for days together, you must have a religious trip.
      The fate of such persons will be more eventful, changeable and largely depending on the fancy and caprice of other people especially of the opposite sex.  This is very often found in the case of public favourites.  Ladies play a great role in their lives.
      Uncertainty of mood is remarkable in their case.  They rarely maintain balanced state of mind.  Either they are in a glad state of mind or in sad state of mind but never mediocre and apparently their may not be any cause.  They are laughing at one moment and gloomy at the next moment.  They can not sit still, either they will be tossing their fingers or their feet must be in movement.  
      They are clean hearted, realize any wrong action done by them quickly as soon as it come to their notice.
      They have literaty aptitude and as such, are good at studies.  They will be considered as intellectuals in society.  Some sort of art will also lit their name in public.
      As far as relations are concerned, it can clearly be defined that such natives are quite faithful, affectionate and loyal relative/friend from their side.  But because of being undue sympathetic and affectionate towards relatives/friends they will be utilized by their associates and consequently they have to face harrassment.  They have numberless friends and create a large social circle.  It is advised that circle must be curtailed.
      They are successful in any job which is concerned with mental labour instead of physical exertion because their qualities are more mental than physical.  Any job related mainly with public dealing, or involving general travelling will also prove beneficial.  Fortune will smile between the age from 25th year to 34th year.  Fortunewise, they do not have to struggle for or material gains rather self created mental strain.  They are considered great traveller.
      Sensitive parts of their body are digestive organs which should be taken care of in general.

Your body is stout, smart and active.  Penetrating and influential eyes, commanding face.  Features though ordinary yet attractive.  Stature is above the average; strong, without being heavy, with a small, thick head.  The face is round and the skin of a reddish hue, have large, bright, daring eyes,the pupils either a brown or a rusty grey, looking at one fixedly and  commanding, the whites more or less bloodshot.  Walk with a brisk, proud and determined step, movements are so quick and unexpected that you often break things around you.     
      You are hasty in by nature.  Can’t sit still when there is some work lying tobe done.  Even you take it ill if your subordinates or associates do their job lithargically.  Are brave, headstrong, impulsive and angersome. Talk in thundering voice. Voice is powerful and of a commanding tone. Neither you like tobe guided by others nor tolerate interference in your affairs. Have great obstinacy of purpose and determination, resent all criticism, seldom ask the advice of others.  Are born fighters in every sense of the word.  Aspire tobe leaders in whatever career you undertake. Are lover of independence, fearless and straightforward.  Can only be  handled or tackled by affection, patience, kindness or tact otherwise they are ready to quarrel to any degree.  Temper is hasty and explosive but at the same time quickly over, and when the storm subsides you bitterly regret for what you have said or done in the heat of the moment.                 
      Anger,  (lack of self control) haste and being sentiment are your weak points which should invariably be controlled. Prefer to die      than begging.  Sleep breaks early in the morning. You are domineering and refuses to listen to reasoning, which you probably would fail to understand.   
      In relationship, you either don’t have elder brother or they will be almost zero for you or below your status.  You will make sacrifices and throw money away for your relatives, even then they will not be on good terms with you.   Number of enemies will be large and less will be friends.  You play treachery only with proved cheating friend. You are destined to face opposition from wife or children. Delayed progeny or there can be miscarriages, once or twice.  Comfort of parents is not indicated. 
      Careerwise, life will be full of struggle, especially early life and luck will start favouring around 28th year of age through your self-efforts and merits.  You will exercise powers in imposing or relaxing penalties. Job will be  adventurous or risky.  You will attain much landed/constructed property in life.  There can arise some litigation/trifle over property wherein you are destined to win the same.  Has plenty of energy and perseverance and will go through any amount of peril and fatigue to bring an enterprise to success. 
      According to Ayurveda, your body is PITTAKARKA (hot type), so you are prone to troubles due to excess of heat in body 
      You seldom get through life without receiving cuts, wounds, or blows to the head or surgical help.  There is also likelihood of fevers and blood diseases, especially in early years.  However, you have rich blood and care a fig for normal temperatures, tolerance is remarkable against pain of ailments.  
      You are advised to cultivate repose, self-control and above all to avoid stimulants.  Should endeavour to sleep more, to take more recreation and exercise in the open air and above all things to curb your pride and control your temper.

You are small of stature but well built, pleasing face, which remains young looking quite late in life.  Complexion is light, of the colour of new honey and the least emotion sends a blush to your cheeks,skin is soft, and the expression of their face very changeable.  Eyes are very quick and penetrating full of cleverness, sometimes restless with yellowish whites and thin eyelids.  Mouth generally half open.  Voice is decidedly weak, lacking sonority.  
      You have nervous bilious temperament.   Prone to mental fatigue, nervous weakness or relating to tongue/voice.  Indigestion caused by nervous worry or anxiety, insomnia.  In reality, you have excellent constitutions, except when you are ruined by taking drugs and medicines.  Avoid taking drugs as much as possible.
      You are quick in thought and action, and are fond of every menifestation in which your mental and physical alertness plays a part.  Great judge of human nature and a clever manager.  You scheme with tireless activity and possess a real influence over your fellow beings.  Your eloquence is built on facts, not on fancies, and triumph is that of quick, limpid logic. Gifted eloquence, smiling, sociable, easily mixing nature and witty orator. Talk in slow but quick manner, dramatically waving hands and making different poses; successful in copying others’ actions etc. and successful in gossip.  You  cannot sit still or can’t sit silent for long.  Mood is more of the merry, mildly-mocking kind.  Fond of travelling.  Controlled anger, temperament changing according to circumstances.  You are opportunistic, and have flexible nature.  You are full of informations but do not rely upon it, possessed with unusual intelligence but lack of continuity in your plans and in purpose spoil due rise.  Possess sharp memory, restless nature, and jack of trades. Excellent in diplomacy and criticism.   
      You have a large number of friends.  Fortune will rise through business.  Sources of income will be numerous and new ones. You will be gainer through matters related with travelling, commission-agent, quackery, lottery, speculation, and through befooling others. You will change many professions in life.  Will have more than one or two sources of income at a time too.  Fortune will smile around 32nd year of age.

You   are   strongly  built  and  of middle height, rather fleshy. Voice is sonorous, eyes are large, smiling and melting, grow stout rather early in life.  You perspire abundantly.  Walk in a quiet, stately manner.  Appear matured than your age. 
      You are both bilious and sanguine in temperament.  Being a great drinker   and eater, bound to suffer from indulgence in that respect.  Subjected  to   pains   in joints, cough ailments or liver weakness.  You are slow to anger and slow to slow down.
      You   are   full of confidence in yourself.  Essentially good natured  and often warm hearted and charitable.  Apt to spend money  too freely and show a somewhat exaggerate contempt for every-thing   mean  and miserly.  Are religiously inclined but are fond of splendid ceremonies and of outward show show of every kind.  You are born aristocrats and conservative to a degree. Believe in law, order and   discipline   in  all spheres of life.  Love peace but hate all cheating  and   deceipt and will fight without hesitation anyone who tramples upon their beloved tenets.  You are easily pleased and keep your friends.
      You are easily out of poverty and puberty,are born lucky and helped to success by your being a general favourite.  You will be like a GURU in your sphere, may it be service or business. Career will  be  of  easy-going  and comfortable, not requiring phusical or mental  exertion.  You will enjoy all material comforts like landed/constructed  property.  Either  birth will be in rich family or you will rise tremendously.  Luck will favour in studies. 
      You   will   serve   your parents, brothers and sisters. Conjugal life not guaranteed for satisfaction.

You have an attractive face, less wrinkles on face, beautiful eyebrows.  Appears young as compared to real age.  Toss head while talking. In stature, above the medium height, with a round face wherein no bone is apparent and the brows are beatifully and finely curved, hair of eye brows are abundant and silky but not joined.  Hair is long, dark coloured, plentiful and supple; you keep it until late in ife.  
      You are strong and healthy, temperament is nervous-sanguine, a most desirable combination.  Cheerful disposition carries you over many minor troubles.  You are prone to ailments related with throat, urinary track or generative organs. 
      You are worshipper of cleanliness and beauty both inside your home as well surroundings, dress with great taste.  You are sweet smelling, sociable, and possess popular persnonality.  You are slow to anger, hospitable and generous and especially love to entertain your friends and guests, thus make wonderfully good hosts, have great taste about food and are generally considered richer than you really are and can make a good show on very little. You are impulsive in your likes and dislikes.  You prefer dainty dishes, rice rather than CHAPATI. Enjoy the life materially fully, as your motto is, “Eat,drink and be merry, for tomorrow you die”.  You love delicate perfumes, the beauties of nature and simple melodious music; such music as goes straight to the heart. The opposite sex plays the most important role in your life and influences your every act. You are truthful and constant and pardon easily and unrestrictedly, hate all forms of quarrelling, strife and warfare.  You are only mildly ambitious.  
      Your career will be of easy-going type.  This may be related with beautiful things, art or medical.  You will enjoy all the amenities and luxuries of life.  Luck will favour  with all the latest and modern luxury items early and easily as compared to others. You will own beatiful home and conveyance. 
      Fortune will favour in studies.  You are inclined in any form of art or music. 
      You have a large circle of faithful and profiteering friends. You take interest in social matters to a high degree.

NATURE:
* You like solitude, hesitate in attending crowdy places, hue and cry rather like peaceful environment.
* Don’t like outer show-off.
* Nature is serious, reserve, sensitive, quite determined, studying serious things, 
* Believing in fatalism and in the ultimate destiny of all things.  You are very much children of fate and circumstances, over which you appear to have no control. 
* Though possess strong will force and mentality, yet feel exceptionally lonely and isolated in going through life.  
* You have the remarkable quality of secrecy, extreme prudence, sadness, lack of veneration and doubter.  
* Prefers investing money where there is a least risk of loss.  
* Have a strange, mysterious gift of assessing things, weights etc.  
* Remarkable for your independence of thought and action and although dislikes to obey but you have to do so.  
* Not fond of the everyday pleasures of life.  
* Cares a little for other people’s society and is not of an lamorous temperament.  Prefers old fashioned classical principles.  
* Though you are slow but steady, patient and tireless
* For kindness and sympathy you will do almost anything, but you feel so isolated that you scarcely believe in the affections that may be offered. Sometimes you feel that there is nobody in the world who can understand your feelings. You have strange ideas of love and duty, and for this reason you are usually called somewhat peculiar by those few who attempt to penetrate your isolation. 
* Feel the responsibilities too heavily and in consequence often become despondent and gloomy. 
* Mysticism and occultism of all kinds appeal very strongly, so you like clever, intellectual people and are deep thinkers in all matters that interest you but you can not brook interference in your views from others.  
* Make a few true friends and can undergo any sacrifice for the sake of a friend but they stop at nothing to avenge an injury if you think you have been deceived/cheated.  
* You have a quite controlling power with your eyes and although highly nervous people yourselves yet you have the greatest control over excitable and nervous patients and also over the insane.  It is a strange fact that in the run of your careers you seem fated to be brought into contact with such cases. Also possess evil eye for enemies. 
* Averse to superstitions yet are religious in your own way.  
* Appear to be a person of ordinary calibre yet you are underground also.  
* In conversation, tone is not dramatic or stylish but plain talk, to the point but with double meaning. Again in conversation, you are usually a silent listener. If compelled to speak, MURDA BOLE KAFAN FARE. 
INTELLIGENCE, EDUCATION:
* Possess philosopher like intelligence, going in depth of things.  Inclined towards study of the old, scientific and technical.  
* Also will come into contact with foreign language.  
* In education, you will lose some division or admission owing to 3-4 marks. There will be some botheration or ailment around your examinations. 
RELATIONS: 
* As far as relations are concerned, there are much responsibilities  and sacrifice on your part and less are the gains overall.  
* You will not be  contented through your younger brother or may be the youngest one in the family.  
* Marriage will be delayed or mutual relations will not be harmonious or wife should be of reserve nature.  Delayed comfort of progeny is indicated. 
LIFE & CAREER:
* Early life not according to your wishes rather adverse circumstances.  
* You will have to start your career from the  rank, one step below than your eligibility permits. Your school mates will be one step ahead than you though those were less talented. Inspite of much qualification/eligibility/talents, you have to remain backward in the run of your life. 
* You have to exert a lot for lesser gains. You acquire a post which is bearing stagnation and heavy assignment as compared to your colleagues. Thus you are on laborious job.  
* Life is full of ups and downs, never mediocre or smooth. Though you are quite labourious yet you are unable to find justice from destiny. 
* You will find fortune away from your native/mother land.  Thereafter, you will find recognition and promotion in life otherwise others will enjoy credit for the tedious/inventive work done by you. 
* Your career must evolve either technical, full of heavy responsibility or heavy exertion or underhand activities. 
* You should be wide awake while acquiring landed/ constructed property.  You are destined to sacrifice or lose some part of property.  
BODY:
* You are either tall, thin or dark complexioned, hairs hard and in abundance on body, have dry and rough skin, easily wrinkled, face is bony, eyes are deepset, dark and generally sad; they glisten only under the influence of anger or suspicion.  
* You twinkle your eyes late and keep eyes-gazing down.
HEALTH:
* You are mentally never relaxed, full of worries and at times under depression.  
* According to Ayurveda, your body is VAYUKARKA, there you are advised to avoid taking such edibles otherwise there can be possibility of any chronic ailment.  
* There is a likelihood of ailments relating to joints or bones, may be due to falling or otherwise, especially leg.  
* Fevers should be taken care of properly as typhoid may tease you.

You are individualistic.  For you, things once decided are decided for ever, and there is not the least effect of others’ advice, though, may your decision prove tobe harmful.  You are fearless, outspoken and frank and talk in rebelious tone, do not let the listener speak while you have started expressing your views. Your weak points are that you are most highly strung and sensitive, very easily wounded in your feelings,inclined to feel lonely and lisolated.  In an argument you usually take the opposite side.  You are a person of your own philosophy.  Frequently break rules and regulations either in domestic or government and feel that you are law maker.  Your views are generally rebellious and you do not care a fig while expressing such views. Attracted to social questions and reforms of all kinds and are very positive and unconventional in your views and opinions.   You hate mediocre or ordinary life, consequently aspire and constantly try to make yourself distinct figure in one way or the other.  You are quite secretive, suspicious, very prudent about any conspiracy against you.  Intolerant and impulsive by nature. 
      Your mind is original, inventive and of a philosopher, going in undue depth of things.  You have a scientific and logical  turn of mind especially on the subjects requiring depth of thought.  In education, either your target will not fulfil or degree of education will not be utilised or marks won’t be according to your labour/expectation.  You may lose some admission or division by 3-4 marks. There may be illness or other natural calamity around examinations.  
      You have a few friends.  You break even long-aged friendship within some moments.  Your fast friend will either be materially/domestically lacking to a remarkable degree otherwise there is danger of treachery. 
      You will have to face losses on account of your friends whereas you will in some way or the other be gainer through your enemies who are numberless and secret.  Enemies, as long as are secret will cheat and tease you but when they are open, instead of harming you they will start try to make  compromise with you otherwise their attack will prove beneficial to you.  Marriage will be delayed; if it is early, difference of opinion may prevail otherwise wife will remain ill or comfort from progeny is suspicious.  You experience lack of love and rather environment of hate, are dry-natured both indoor and outdoor.  
      Success comes to you when there is a little or no charm of it because it is too late or at the eleventh hour.  You face obstacles in almost each and every job you undertake.  Though you are resourceful and there is every help at your disposal. 
      Majority of events come to you in a way - sudden, unexpected, wonderful, explosive and unforeseen.  Life is full of struggles, ups and downs and is revolutionery/rebellious.  Your efforts will not bear fruits according to your input value.  Your life will never be mediocre rather on any extreme.  You do not like below-status job and you do not find the job as per your taste, due to this reason, you will have to remain upset upto either 28th, 31st or 36th year of your age. 
      You will find your fortune at a place away from mother/native place. It may be foreign or any distant place.  You will find help in life not through your own persons rather nature will sent some unexpected person for your help.  You are successful advocate, technical expert or in any adventurous or risky job.  You are not successful in worldly matters.  Your money will not return from your close relatives and friends. You possess an easily distinguishable personality both physically and mentally.

Persons born under the influence of such stars have philosophical facial outlook like that of a thinker.  Often have frail body as you do not care for your health properly. 
      You have affinity with mysticism in one form or another.  Either dreams will be befitting the future or suddenly spoken words will prove true, as you have the gift of intuition, clairvoyance and a peculiar quieting magnetism that has great influence over others.   May it be unnatural problems. 
      You are highly imaginative and much emotional.  This is your weak point which should be taken care of.  You are restless in nature, so you are advised to keep yourself on the move as much as possible.  You love change and travel, attached with foreign directly or indirectly. Care a little about material things of life.  Become rich by original ideas or methods.  You have the remarkable quality of secrecy but you are a phanatic for your purpose which should be controlled. 
      You possess an abnormal or extra intelligence. You are attached with occult-sciences, art or writing etc. 
      Your fast friend will find himself rising day by day after coming in your affinity.  You may or may not rise.  Your enemies or those who have cheated you will meet bitter misfortune automatically. 
      Early life hard and not in accordance with your tastes. There will be mental botherations mostly unnecessary or self-created. You will rise in mental pursuits or in technical jobs.  Fortune will smile during the years 34th or 48th of your age.
